title: Challenging a client's numbers
goal: As an auditor, press a finance director on suspicious receivables.

steps.partner_zh: 报表我们都核对过了，应该没什么问题吧？
steps.partner_en: We've checked the statements; there shouldn't be any problems, right?
steps.prompt_en: Say overall it's fine, but receivables grew much faster than revenue and you need an explanation.
answers_zh: 整体没问题，但应收账款的增速远高于营收，我们需要一个合理的解释。
大部分都没问题，只是应收账款增长了八成，而收入只增长了三成，这点需要说明。
answers_en: Overall it's fine, but receivables grew far faster than revenue; we need a reasonable explanation.
Most of it's fine, but receivables rose eighty percent while revenue rose only thirty; that needs explaining.

steps.partner_zh: 那是因为我们今年放宽了信用政策，为了抢占市场。
steps.partner_en: That's because we loosened credit terms this year to grab market share.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for the board approval of the credit policy change and the ageing analysis.
answers_zh: 那请提供信用政策调整的董事会决议和应收账款账龄分析表。
能否提供政策变更的审批文件，以及应收账款的账龄明细？
answers_en: Then please provide the board resolution on the credit policy change and the receivables ageing analysis.
Could you provide the approval documents for the policy change and a detailed ageing of receivables?

steps.partner_zh: 这些……需要一点儿时间整理。
steps.partner_en: Those... will take a little time to put together.
steps.prompt_en: Say that's fine, but you'll also need to send confirmation letters to the top ten customers directly.
answers_zh: 可以理解，另外我们会直接向前十大客户发函询证。
没关系，不过前十大客户的余额我们需要独立发函确认。
answers_en: Understood; also, we'll send confirmation requests directly to the top ten customers.
No problem, but we'll need to independently confirm the top ten customers' balances.

steps.partner_zh: 有这个必要吗？这些都是长期合作的客户。
steps.partner_en: Is that necessary? These are all long-standing clients.
steps.prompt_en: Explain firmly but politely that it's a standard procedure and protects both sides.
answers_zh: 这是审计准则要求的标准程序，其实也是对贵公司的一种保护。
这是常规程序，并不是针对贵公司，结果清楚了对双方都好。
answers_en: It's a standard procedure required by auditing standards, and actually protects your company too.
It's routine, not aimed at you; clear results are good for both sides.

closing_zh: 好吧，我让团队配合你们。
closing_en: Fine, I'll have my team cooperate with you.

title: Lending to an exhibition
goal: Negotiate terms for lending your archive pieces to a museum.

steps.partner_zh: 我们非常希望借展您收藏的那几件九十年代作品。
steps.partner_en: We'd very much like to borrow those nineties pieces from your collection.
steps.prompt_en: Say you're honoured, but first ask about conservation conditions in the gallery.
answers_zh: 很荣幸，不过我想先了解一下展厅的保存条件。
这是我的荣幸。请问展厅的温湿度和光照是怎么控制的？
answers_en: I'm honoured, but I'd first like to know about the gallery's conservation conditions.
It's an honour. How are temperature, humidity and lighting controlled in the gallery?

steps.partner_zh: 恒温恒湿，照明也低于五十勒克斯，符合纺织品标准。
steps.partner_en: Constant temperature and humidity, lighting under fifty lux, meeting textile standards.
steps.prompt_en: Say good; then ask who covers insurance and transport.
answers_zh: 那很好。保险和运输费用由哪一方承担？
听起来很专业。保险和运输是博物馆负责吗？
answers_en: Good. Which party covers insurance and transport?
Sounds very professional. Does the museum handle insurance and transport?

steps.partner_zh: 全部由我们承担，按您提供的估价全额投保。
steps.partner_en: We cover it all, insured in full at your valuation.
steps.prompt_en: Request that the pieces are displayed on custom mannequins, not hung.
answers_zh: 另外，希望展品用定制的人台展示，不要直接悬挂。
我有个要求：衣服不能挂着，最好按尺寸定做人台。
answers_en: Also, I'd like the pieces shown on custom mannequins rather than hung.
One request: the clothes mustn't be hung; ideally use made-to-measure mannequins.

steps.partner_zh: 没问题。展签上希望怎么署名？
steps.partner_en: No problem. How would you like to be credited on the labels?
steps.prompt_en: Say 'private collection' is enough; you prefer to stay anonymous.
answers_zh: 写“私人收藏”就可以，我不想公开姓名。
署“私人藏家”即可，我希望保持匿名。
answers_en: "Private collection" is fine; I'd rather not give my name.
Just "private collector"; I'd like to stay anonymous.

closing_zh: 完全尊重您的意见，合同草稿下周发给您。
closing_en: We fully respect that; the draft contract will reach you next week.

title: Pitching to an investor
goal: Defend your startup's numbers under tough questions.

steps.partner_zh: 你们的用户增长很快，但我更关心的是留存率。
steps.partner_en: Your user growth is fast, but I care more about retention.
steps.prompt_en: Say thirty-day retention is forty percent, well above the industry average.
answers_zh: 我们三十天留存率是百分之四十，明显高于行业平均水平。
次月留存稳定在四成左右，比同行高出不少。
answers_en: Our thirty-day retention is forty percent, clearly above the industry average.
Month-two retention is steady at about forty percent, well above peers.

steps.partner_zh: 获客成本呢？现在流量越来越贵。
steps.partner_en: And customer acquisition cost? Traffic keeps getting pricier.
steps.prompt_en: Say most users come from referrals, so acquisition cost has fallen for three quarters.
answers_zh: 我们大部分新用户来自老用户推荐，获客成本已经连续三个季度下降。
六成以上的用户是口碑带来的，所以获客成本一直在降。
answers_en: Most new users come from referrals, so acquisition cost has fallen for three straight quarters.
Over sixty percent of users come via word of mouth, so acquisition cost keeps falling.

steps.partner_zh: 那你们什么时候能实现盈亏平衡？
steps.partner_en: So when will you break even?
steps.prompt_en: Say that with this round, you expect to break even in eighteen months.
answers_zh: 如果这轮融资到位，我们预计十八个月内实现盈亏平衡。
按现在的增长，拿到这轮资金后大约一年半能打平。
answers_en: If this round closes, we expect to break even within eighteen months.
At current growth, with this round we'd break even in about eighteen months.

steps.partner_zh: 估值方面，你们的要价偏高了。
steps.partner_en: On valuation, your ask is on the high side.
steps.prompt_en: Stay firm: say the price reflects your margins, but you're open to discussing the terms.
answers_zh: 这个估值是基于我们的毛利水平，不过具体条款我们可以商量。
价格反映的是我们的盈利能力，但在条款上我们愿意灵活一些。
answers_en: The valuation is based on our margins, but we can discuss the specific terms.
The price reflects our profitability, but we're willing to be flexible on terms.

closing_zh: 好，把详细的财务模型发给我，我们内部讨论一下。
closing_en: OK, send me the detailed financial model and we'll discuss internally.

title: Football podcast debate
goal: Argue on a podcast about money in football.

steps.partner_zh: 有人说，没有资本，就没有今天的顶级足球。你同意吗？
steps.partner_en: Some say without capital there'd be no top-level football today. Do you agree?
steps.prompt_en: Agree capital raised standards, but argue it has widened the gap between clubs.
answers_zh: 资本确实提高了比赛水平，但也拉大了俱乐部之间的差距。
我同意一半：钱带来了更好的比赛，却让强弱分化越来越严重。
answers_en: Capital has raised the standard of play, but it has also widened the gap between clubs.
I half agree: money brought better football, but made the divide between strong and weak ever sharper.

steps.partner_zh: 可是强队本来就会更强，这不是自然规律吗？
steps.partner_en: But strong teams naturally get stronger; isn't that just how it goes?
steps.prompt_en: Say without regulation that's true, which is why spending caps matter.
answers_zh: 如果没有监管，的确会这样，所以财政公平规则才这么重要。
正因为这样，才需要工资帽之类的制度来维持竞争。
answers_en: Without regulation, yes, which is exactly why financial fair play rules matter so much.
That's precisely why systems like salary caps are needed to keep competition alive.

steps.partner_zh: 但这些规则执行起来漏洞百出。
steps.partner_en: But these rules are full of loopholes in practice.
steps.prompt_en: Concede that, but say imperfect rules beat no rules.
answers_zh: 这我承认，不过有缺陷的规则总比没有规则强。
执行确实有问题，但不能因此就否定规则本身。
answers_en: I'll admit that, but flawed rules are better than none.
Enforcement has problems, but that's no reason to reject the rules themselves.

steps.partner_zh: 最后，用一句话总结你的观点。
steps.partner_en: Finally, sum up your view in one sentence.
steps.prompt_en: Say football can welcome money, but must not be owned by it.
answers_zh: 足球可以欢迎资本，但不能被资本绑架。
钱可以为足球服务，但足球不能只为钱服务。
answers_en: Football can welcome capital, but must not be held hostage by it.
Money can serve football, but football mustn't serve only money.

closing_zh: 说得好！感谢今天的精彩讨论。
closing_en: Well said! Thanks for a great discussion today.

title: Supporting a grieving friend
goal: Comfort a friend whose grandmother has died, with the right words.

steps.partner_zh: 我奶奶上周走了……我到现在还不敢相信。
steps.partner_en: My grandma passed away last week... I still can't believe it.
steps.prompt_en: Express your condolences and say you're here if they need anything.
answers_zh: 太突然了，请节哀。有什么需要帮忙的，随时告诉我。
听到这个消息我很难过。你需要什么，我都在。
answers_en: So sudden; I'm so sorry for your loss. Tell me anytime if there's anything I can do.
I'm so sad to hear it. Whatever you need, I'm here.

steps.partner_zh: 我最后悔的是，今年春节都没回去看她。
steps.partner_en: What I regret most is not going home to see her this Spring Festival.
steps.prompt_en: Gently say she surely understood, and knew how much you loved her.
answers_zh: 她一定能理解的，她肯定知道你有多爱她。
别太自责了，奶奶心里一直都明白你的心意。
answers_en: She'd surely have understood; she must have known how much you loved her.
Don't blame yourself too much; your grandma always knew how you felt.

steps.partner_zh: 她以前总给我包饺子，说是我最爱吃的。
steps.partner_en: She always used to make me dumplings, said they were my favourite.
steps.prompt_en: Ask if they'd like to make dumplings together this weekend, to remember her.
answers_zh: 要不这个周末我们一起包饺子吧，就当是纪念她。
周末我陪你包一次饺子，好不好？也算是怀念奶奶。
answers_en: How about we make dumplings together this weekend, to remember her?
Shall I make dumplings with you this weekend? A way of remembering her.

steps.partner_zh: ……好。谢谢你。
steps.partner_en: ...OK. Thank you.
steps.prompt_en: Say there's no need for thanks, and that you'll come round on Saturday.
answers_zh: 跟我还客气什么，周六我过去找你。
不用谢，周六下午我带面粉过去。
answers_en: No need to stand on ceremony with me; I'll come over on Saturday.
No need to thank me; I'll bring the flour on Saturday afternoon.

title: Town hall on tourism
goal: Voice a resident's concerns about overtourism at a local meeting.

steps.partner_zh: 今天开会是想听听居民对旅游开发的意见。
steps.partner_en: Today's meeting is to hear residents' views on tourism development.
steps.prompt_en: Say tourism has helped shops, but noise and short-lets are driving residents out.
answers_zh: 旅游确实带动了商铺，但噪音和短租房正在把老居民挤走。
我不反对旅游，只是现在短租太多，很多老邻居都搬走了。
answers_en: Tourism has certainly helped the shops, but noise and short-lets are pushing long-time residents out.
I'm not against tourism, but there are too many short-lets now; lots of old neighbours have moved away.

steps.partner_zh: 你有什么具体的建议吗？
steps.partner_en: Do you have any concrete suggestions?
steps.prompt_en: Propose capping short-let days per year and quiet hours after ten.
answers_zh: 建议限制短租每年的出租天数，并规定晚上十点以后保持安静。
可以给短租设一个年度天数上限，再定一个夜间静音时段。
answers_en: I suggest capping short-lets' rental days per year and requiring quiet after 10 pm.
Set an annual day limit on short-lets, and designate night-time quiet hours.

steps.partner_zh: 这样会不会影响本地的经济收入？
steps.partner_en: Won't that hurt local income?
steps.prompt_en: Argue that a liveable neighbourhood is what attracts tourists in the first place.
answers_zh: 短期可能有影响，但游客来这里，本来就是为了看真实的社区生活。
如果居民都走了，这里就只剩空壳，游客也不会再来。
answers_en: There may be a short-term hit, but tourists come here to see real neighbourhood life in the first place.
If the residents all leave, it'll be an empty shell and tourists won't come either.

steps.partner_zh: 你的意见我们会认真考虑。
steps.partner_en: We'll consider your views seriously.
steps.prompt_en: Ask for a concrete timeline and a follow-up meeting.
answers_zh: 希望能给出一个具体的时间表，下个月再开一次会跟进。
能不能定个时间，下次开会时告诉我们进展？
answers_en: I'd like a concrete timetable, and a follow-up meeting next month.
Could you set a date and update us on progress at the next meeting?

closing_zh: 可以，我们下个月十五号再开一次。
closing_en: Agreed; we'll meet again on the fifteenth of next month.

title: Discussing a translation
goal: Defend your translation choices to an editor.

steps.partner_zh: 你把原文的这个比喻完全换掉了，为什么？
steps.partner_en: You completely replaced this metaphor from the original. Why?
steps.prompt_en: Say a literal translation would confuse Chinese readers, so you used an equivalent idiom.
answers_zh: 直译的话中文读者会看不懂，所以我用了一个意思相近的成语。
原文的比喻有文化背景，照搬会让读者困惑，我就换成了对应的说法。
answers_en: A literal translation would confuse Chinese readers, so I used an idiom with a similar meaning.
The metaphor is culturally rooted; copying it would confuse readers, so I swapped in an equivalent expression.

steps.partner_zh: 可是这样会不会丢掉作者的风格？
steps.partner_en: But won't that lose the author's style?
steps.prompt_en: Concede the risk, and offer to keep the original image in a footnote.
answers_zh: 确实有这个风险，我可以在脚注里保留原来的意象。
这点您说得对，要不我加个注释，把原文的比喻说明一下？
answers_en: That's a real risk; I can keep the original image in a footnote.
You're right; shall I add a note explaining the original metaphor?

steps.partner_zh: 脚注太多会影响阅读节奏。
steps.partner_en: Too many footnotes will disrupt the reading rhythm.
steps.prompt_en: Suggest a compromise: footnotes only for key recurring images.
answers_zh: 那折中一下，只给反复出现的关键意象加注。
可以只在最重要、会反复出现的地方加注，其他的就意译。
answers_en: Then a compromise: notes only for key recurring images.
Notes only where the image is most important and recurs; translate the rest freely.

steps.partner_zh: 这个方案可以。交稿时间没问题吧？
steps.partner_en: That works. The deadline's fine, right?
steps.prompt_en: Confirm you'll deliver the revised draft by the end of the month.
answers_zh: 没问题，月底前一定交修改稿。
放心，这个月底我把修订版发给您。
answers_en: No problem, the revised draft will be in by the end of the month.
Don't worry, I'll send you the revised version by month's end.

closing_zh: 好，辛苦了，期待你的修改稿。
closing_en: Great, thanks for your work. Looking forward to the revision.

title: Career advice from a mentor
goal: Discuss whether to stay in audit or move into investment.

steps.partner_zh: 听说你在考虑跳槽去做投资？
steps.partner_en: I hear you're thinking of moving into investment?
steps.prompt_en: Say yes; audit taught you a lot, but you want to be closer to decisions.
answers_zh: 是的，审计让我学到了很多，但我更想参与到决策当中。
对，审计打下了基础，不过我希望离决策更近一些。
answers_en: Yes; audit taught me a lot, but I want to be part of the decision-making.
Right; audit gave me the foundation, but I'd like to be closer to the decisions.

steps.partner_zh: 投资的压力和不确定性可比审计大多了。
steps.partner_en: Investment has far more pressure and uncertainty than audit.
steps.prompt_en: Say you know, and that's partly why you want to try it while you're young.
answers_zh: 我知道，正因为这样，我才想趁年轻去试一试。
我明白，可是年轻的时候不试，以后可能就更没勇气了。
answers_en: I know, and that's exactly why I want to try it while I'm young.
I understand, but if I don't try while I'm young, I may never have the nerve later.

steps.partner_zh: 那你的专业资格证还考吗？
steps.partner_en: Will you still finish your professional qualification?
steps.prompt_en: Say definitely: reading financial statements is the core skill either way.
answers_zh: 一定要考完，不管做什么，看懂报表都是核心能力。
当然会，读懂财务报表在投资里一样是基本功。
answers_en: Definitely; whatever I do, understanding financial statements is the core skill.
Of course; reading statements is just as fundamental in investment.

steps.partner_zh: 想清楚了就去吧。有什么需要，随时来找我。
steps.partner_en: If you've thought it through, go for it. Come to me anytime you need anything.
steps.prompt_en: Thank them sincerely for years of guidance.
answers_zh: 真的很感谢您这几年的指导。
这些年多亏了您的提携，我一直记在心里。
answers_en: Thank you so much for your guidance these past few years.
I owe a lot to your support over the years; I'll always remember it.

closing_en: Do well, and don't forget to keep in touch.
